numbers._note: M8 step 1b (docs/DESIGN.md, 'World generation, details'; the user's decisions 2026-10-24, the exact numbers my picks, to confirm): dead_share, of the mounds how many are dead (real surveys: a third to a half); living_stages, bands of mound stage (1 to 32) and their weights for living colonies (the user's table 2026-10-24: giant cathedrals rare, most mounds small; stages 1 to 3 never, a first-year colony has no mound to see; the colony's workers and age follow its stage); dead_sizes, the same for the size a dead mound had stood to (tilted bigger: big mounds stand for decades, small dead ones wash away fast); dead_stages, weights of freshly dead (0-3 days), wearing (3-12), slumping (12-30) and old grassy humps (35-200); hump_woods, of the old humps how many have trees or a thicket on them (real mound islands); aardvark_burrows, of the old humps how many an aardvark has dug a burrow into, down to the old nest (0 turns it off); hump_grass, greener grass on the old humps (false turns it off).
